title: Used Car Inspection Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Used Vehicle Inspection: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Used Car Inspection Estimate Worksheet covers vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input. The vehicle inspection coordinator records Used Vehicle Inspection observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Used Car Inspection Estimate Worksheet keeps Used Vehicle Inspection exceptions visible until the vehicle inspection coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Used Car Inspection Estimate Worksheet at inspection facility, lift bay, controlled test route, and document review area. Document vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input identity before Used Vehicle Inspection begins. Compare vehicle identity, history representation, visible condition, system test, measurement, limitation, and purchase decision input findings with stated Used Vehicle Inspection criteria; route unresolved Used Vehicle Inspection issues to qualified independent automotive reviewer. For Used Car Inspection Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Used Vehicle Inspection. Ask qualified independent automotive reviewer to review Used Vehicle Inspection conditions beyond the vehicle inspection coordinator's role.
